courseJsonLd.name: Introduction to Monitoring Air Quality on the Job Site
courseJsonLd.description: This course develops practical, on-site air quality monitoring skills for restoration technicians. Participants will learn how to identify airborne contaminants, select and operate monitoring equipment, apply safety protocols, and produce compliant field documentation — all within Australian workplace health and safety (WHS) requirements and IICRC best practices.
